text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With training time fast approaching,
Fuji Kiseki was out shopping when—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All set...!
Now, did I forget to buy anything else—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... you're Fuji Kiseki-san, right!
I'm always watching your races! I love you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true!?
Haha, that makes me glad."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To think I could completely captivate the gaze
of such a cute little pony like you... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My family and friends are huge fans too!
Could I please get your autograph if it's okay?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sure... as many as you want, dozens even.
As long as my arms can move, I'll devote myself to you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful...!
In-in that case, I'd like 100 copies, please!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, sure thing...! Of course I'll sign it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "It must be tough waiting around here. Why don't we grab some tea at a café while I sign these?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fuji Kiseki ended up
skipping training entirely...
